item.title: Aquis weekly movers: Ajax Resources starts environmental permit process in Brazil
item.summary: Delta Gold Technologies (LON: DGQ) director Jamie Tosh bought 20,000 shares at 122p each. He owns 5.7%. Delta Gold Technologies has raised £30,000 from an exercise of warrants at 15p each. The share price gained 8.7% to 125p. FALLERS Shareholders voted in favour of the restructuring of the share capital of NYCE International (LON: NYCE).
